Question Choices: An elevator can carry at most 800 kg. Equipment weighs 200 kg, and each person is counted as 100 kg. What is the greatest number of people allowed?
Solution: For p people, 200 + 100p ≤ 800. Thus p ≤ (800 - 200)/100 = 6. Since p is a nonnegative whole number, the greatest allowed count is 6; one more person would exceed the limit.

Question Choices: A liquid starts at 20°C and cools 3°C per hour. It must stay above 8°C. Let h be the elapsed hours since cooling began. Enter the complete range of h for which it stays above 8°C.
Hints: Write 20 - 3h > 8.|The sign reverses when dividing by -3.|Elapsed time starts at zero: h ≥ 0.
Solution: The temperature condition is 20 - (3)h > 8. Subtract 20, then divide by -3 and reverse the sign to get h < 4. Elapsed time also satisfies h ≥ 0. Combining the conditions gives 0 ≤ h < 4. At h = 4 the temperature is exactly 8°C, so that endpoint is excluded.
